orderName: Steel and Steel Products (Quality Control) Order, 2020
summary: Prohibits manufacture, import, distribution, sale, or storage for sale of specified steel products without displaying the Standard Mark under a license from BIS.

orderName: Food Safety and Standards (Packaging & Mandatory Certification) Regulations
issuingMinistry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare / FSSAI
summary: Mandates that no person shall manufacture, sell, or exhibit for sale packaged drinking water except under a BIS certification mark.

orderName: Hallmarking of Gold Jewellery and Gold Artefacts Order, 2020
issuingMinistry: Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution
summary: Phased compulsory hallmarking of gold jewellery with 6-digit Hallmarking Unique ID (HUID) across designated districts in India.

orderName: Electronics and Information Technology Goods (Requirement for Compulsory Registration) Order, 2012
issuingMinistry: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY)
summary: Mandates self-declaration of conformity and registration under BIS Compulsory Registration Scheme (CRS) prior to sale or import into India.

issuingMinistry: Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT)
summary: Mandates BIS ISI Mark under Scheme-I for all electric and non-electric toys intended for children below 14 years.
